lines: And a faint sense of nostalgia.
It was a nightmare I'd seen many times.
(Come to think of it, I haven't had it lately...)
I looked up to the sky.
Far above in the red-stained night sky, a silvery moon was shining silently.
She let fly a kunai from her hand.
But the male shinobi had repelled it.
It was such a heavy kunai that it was hard to believe that it had been launched from that slender arm.
But that was all she could do.
The girl in question was an immature-looking kunoichi of about 11 or 12 years of age.
Even so, he had no intention of going easy on her.
All Fuma ninja had to be eliminated. For the prosperity of the Igawa Clan.
He would at least kill her quickly. As a shinobi that was what the man believed.
He repelled the kunai thrown by the girl one after another.
Two kunai, then three... All of them.
Suddenly, the girl's figure shifted in the man's vision.
It was his own body that had shifted.
Before he knew it, the man's stance had collapsed despite thinking he had repelled all of her kunai.
A kunai glinted keenly in her hand.
The girl threw the knife no differently than those before.
And it flew straight toward the man's forehead.
The man breathed his last, unable to understand why he had been defeated.
Without so much as a glance at the dying man, the girl turned and shouted.
Who goes there!? Who goes there!!?
Several ninja who appeared to be her retainers immediately jumped out to attend to her.
The girl's name was Fuma Tokiko.
Although she was only the tender age of 11, her abilities were well-established.
A girl who was known as a "genius," and next in line as butler of the Taimanin's prestigious Fuma head family.
In addition, her father had been the head of the Fuma head family, Fuma Danjo Kotaro, also known as Fuma Danjo.
The enemy is the Igawa Ninja Forces. Our main force is with the master and our allies are in an unfavorable position...!
All areas of Fuma Village are aflame. We're in a state of confusion and cannot contact the outside.
But rest assured that the master will sense the village's plight, and reinforcements willー
There's nothing to hide. The fact that the Igawa attacked our Fuma Village means that the master was defeated, does it not?
Th-there has certainly been report of the master's death in battle, but...
Considering that it's the master, such a thing shouldn't be possible. Perhaps they're groundless rumors from those Igawa...?
Now is the time to assume the worst and act accordingly.
With those words, Tokiko held back the wishful thinking of her retainers, who were trying to cling to a glimmer of hope.
They were Fuma, the clan who had risen in revolt against Gosha.
Everyone living in Fuma Village had believed the Fuma Ninja Forces would be victorious.
However, that belief had been shattered by the reality of this raid.
But the mere 11-year-old kunoichi girl sharply rebuked her flustered retainers.
Even if the master's death is true, and the heroes of the Fuma Ninja Forces were defeated...
...we haven't lost yet, not as long as the young lord lives!
She meant the Fuma head family's heir.
Who also just happened to be her brother. Her half-brother more specifically since they did not share the same mother.
W-, with all due respect...!!! I saw an attendant escort the young lord back to the residence after we were pushed back by the Igawa.
If it were true, it was possible that the young lord was left alone in the burning residence with no escort.
Hold the enemy at bay here! I will save the young lord.
Gather the survivors, get the troops back in formation, and take up a defensive position. We'll make a final stand against the Igawa Ninja Forces.
The fate of the Fuma rests on this battle. Go, all of you!
Tokiko then rushed off to the burning residence by herself.
The intensity of flames were growing.
One section of the manor was already starting to crumble.
The bright red blaze spread, and the sound of the building materials burning to the ground echoed throughout.
Mixed in among them, the out-of-place clangs of people crossing blades could be heard.
I'll never hand over the young lord!!
In an inner room going up in flames...
A lone masked kunoichi was in the midst of a fierce battle with the Igawa ninja to defend the Fuma heir.
She must have been quite skilled, as several of her enemies' corpses were already lying on the burning tatami mats around her.
However, defending an infant who could do nothing to defend itself was bound to inevitably create openings.
And worst of all, the last remaining enemy was a Fire Art user to whom the flames were nothing.
The kunoichi had already sustained deep wounds all over her body.
The enemy thrust forward with his burning blade.
By the time she realized that she couldn't avoid it, the kunoichi had caught the blade with her own body.
The fatal blade pierced deep into the center of the chest.
It's a waste of a good body, but the mission comes first, doesn't it!? Now burn!
The Fire Art user gripped her by the neck and lifted her up, as if he was claiming his victory by doing so.
Flames then engulfed her entire body.
Y-, young lord... This is... farewell.
The mouth of the kunoichi's mask opened.
With the last ounce of her strength, the kunoichi spat something out of her mouth.
It had unerringly stuck into the enemy's eye.
But even as the man howled in rage from the bite of his cornered pray, the kunoichi's life had already flickered out.
And he himself followed after her no more than a few seconds after that.
The man's face had rapidly turned purple from his eye having been pierced by the needle, and he drew his last breath in agony.
The two collapsed into a heap and eventually became one with the massive blaze.
The only one who remained was the young lord of the Fuma, who was only three years old.
He was standing there stunned, as if he couldn't comprehend what had just happened in front of him.
That was when Tokiko had burst in.
You're safe, I'm so very glad.
The moment he saw her face, Kotaro looked ready to burst into tears.
Yes, Tokiko is here now, you can rest easy.
But big sister, Kikyo... Kikyo is...
His young hands shaking, Kotaro had pointed to the kunoichi who had perished in the flames protecting him.
Kikyo has carried out her duty. Please think only of your survival now.
The child gave a trembling nod.
Please listen to me, young lord. You are now the master of the Fuma head family.
And I, Tokiko, am your butler, you understand, yes?
Kotaro let out a small gasp.
Large tears began to overflow from his round eyes.
Stop crying! You are Fuma Kotaro, head of the Fuma family!
He had the look of a kid brother trying to rely on his elder sister.
A hint of affection had appeared in Tokiko's eyes for a brief moment, but she dispelled it and spoke quietly.
From now on, call me Tokiko. Your big sister has become your foremost retainer, young lord.
Kotaro wiped away his tears and stood up admirably.
That's my young lord. No, my master.
Now then, master, please hide behind Tokiko's back and don't get separated.
Tokiko lifted him onto her back.
Tokiko hadn't even noticed, but her own eyes were faintly moist with tears.
Was it joy at the birth of the head of the Fuma Clan, or sadness from giving up her role as his sister?
Regardless of the feelings of the siblings, or rather the master and servant, a new enemy had appeared in the spacious burning room.
They're here!!! That brat's the heir!!!
The one who takes the kid's head gets the most credit tonight!!!
You dogs of Igawa!! I won't let you lay a single finger on the master of the Fuma!!
The eyes of the kunoichi, Fuma Tokiko, had been lit ablaze.
And those eyes burned stronger and more intense than any of the flames surrounding her.
